IncludesDialogVideoInfo.xml.new_block:
<control type="radiobutton" id="562">
								<visible>!$EXP[IsEpisodeDBType]</visible>
                                <visible>Skin.HasSetting(videoinfo_button_trakt)</visible>
                                <visible>$EXP[IsTvShowDBTypeNoFallback] | $EXP[IsMovieDBTypeNoFallback]</visible>
								<visible>!$EXP[IsSetDBType] + !Window.IsActive(1116) + !Window.IsActive(tvrecordings)</visible>
								<include content="Bingie_InfoDialog_Button_Texture">
                                    <param name="radiotexture" value="dialogs/videoinfo/info/trakt.png"/>
                                </include>
								<textcolor>$INFO[Skin.String(BingieButtonTextColor)]</textcolor>
								<focusedcolor>$INFO[Skin.String(BingieSecondaryButtonFocusTextColor)]</focusedcolor>
								<texturefocus border="10" background="true" colordiffuse="$INFO[Skin.String(ViewDetailsBorderFocusColor)]">bingie/border/default_button_focus.png</texturefocus>
								<texturenofocus/>
                                <label>$LOCALIZE[31153]</label>
                             	<height>52</height>
								<width>224</width>	
								<textwidth>161</textwidth>			
                                <aligny>center</aligny>
								<align>left</align>
								<textoffsetx>55</textoffsetx>
								<textoffsety>7</textoffsety>	
                                <radioposx>12</radioposx>
                                <radiowidth>26</radiowidth>
                                <radioheight>26</radioheight>
                                <onclick condition="!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Property(tmdb_id))">RunScript(plugin.video.tmdb.bingie.helper,sync_trakt,tmdb_id=$INFO[ListItem.Property(tmdb_id)],$VAR[Path_Param_Type],cache_refresh)</onclick>
								<onclick condition="String.IsEmpty(ListItem.Property(tmdb_id))">RunScript(plugin.video.tmdb.bingie.helper,sync_trakt,tmdb_id=$INFO[Container(17195).ListItem.Property(tmdb_id)],$VAR[Path_Param_Type],cache_refresh)</onclick>
                            </control>

							<!-- Go to Season (XStream Player) -->
                            <control type="radiobutton" id="563">
                                <visible>String.IsEqual(ListItem.dbtype,tvshow) + String.IsEmpty(ListItem.DBID) + String.IsEqual(ListItem.Path,plugin://plugin.video.tmdb.bingie.helper/)</visible>
                                <visible>!String.IsEmpty(ListItem.UniqueID(tmdb))</visible>
                                <visible>System.HasAddon(plugin.video.xstream-player)</visible>
                                <include content="Bingie_InfoDialog_Button_Texture">
                                    <param name="radiotexture" value="dialogs/videoinfo/info/more_episodes.png"/>
                                </include>
                                <textcolor>$INFO[Skin.String(BingieButtonTextColor)]</textcolor>
                                <focusedcolor>$INFO[Skin.String(BingieSecondaryButtonFocusTextColor)]</focusedcolor>
                                <texturefocus border="10" background="true" colordiffuse="$INFO[Skin.String(ViewDetailsBorderFocusColor)]">bingie/border/default_button_focus.png</texturefocus>
                                <texturenofocus/>
                                <label>Go to Season</label>
                                <height>52</height>
                                <width>224</width>
                                <textwidth>161</textwidth>
                                <aligny>center</aligny>
                                <align>left</align>
                                <textoffsetx>57</textoffsetx>
                                <textoffsety>7</textoffsety>
                                <radioposx>15</radioposx>
                                <radiowidth>24</radiowidth>
                                <radioheight>24</radioheight>
                                <onclick>Dialog.Close(movieinformation)</onclick>
                                <onclick>RunPlugin(plugin://plugin.video.xstream-player/?mode=goto_show_season_by_name&showname=$ESCINFO[ListItem.Title]&year=$ESCINFO[ListItem.Year]&profile_num=1)</onclick>
                            </control>
